DIAGNOSIS READY: Benign Paroxysmal Positional Vertigo (BPPV).

The clinical picture of sudden, position-dependent vertigo in a 70-year-old with presbycusis, and the exclusion of Meniere's disease via normal audiometry, strongly supports this diagnosis. I recommend performing a Dix-Hallpike maneuver to confirm the diagnosis and identify the affected canal.
